name: us1-config-idempotent
description: The deterministic config ceremony (US1). Running `config --json` against an unchanged company-managed project must produce a byte-identical run summary on stdout, a byte-identical written config.local.yml (the resolved-id table filled by discovery), an identical Jira read-only call sequence, and the same exit code on both ports (FR-003, SC-004, NFR-1). The committed config.yml is never rewritten, so it survives byte-for-byte.
